summary: Ardmore Shipping filed a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results press release, the standard US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer rather than a special-situation event. Reported net income was $16.3 million ($0.40 per share) for Q3 and $100.4 million for nine months; the board declared a $0.27 per-share quarterly dividend payable December 15, 2026, to holders of record November 27. Disclosed vessel sales—Ardmore Endeavour for $34.3 million and Ardmore Engineer's $12.2 million gain—are routine fleet recycling, not a divestiture event. No deal terms apply.
